---
title: Time off
keywords: vacation, holiday, PTO, leave
---

We offer unlimited time off, with an expectation that everyone takes at least 25 days off a year, including public holidays.

## Booking time off

You do not need approval from your manager. Coordinate with your team so a whole team is never out at once, then book the days in the time off app.

## Parental leave

Parental leave depends on how long you have been with the company:

- Under 6 months: 3 weeks
- 6 to 12 months: 12 weeks
- Over 12 months: up to 24 weeks

Log parental leave at least 4 months before it begins.

## Jury duty

If you are summoned for jury duty, tell the people team right away. We can often get an exception if there is enough notice.
